title: Yummy Moroccan Red Meat Tangia
description: Savory, light, and easy to prepare, this Moroccan dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It's dairy-free-friendly and packed with flavor!
instructions: Season the beef with salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the red wine vinegar, bonito flakes, and cilantro to the pot. Stir to combine.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the meat and sauce hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Note: Traditionally, tangia is cooked in a clay pot over a wood fire. This recipe adapts the dish for a conventional oven.
